palettes.title: φ  Fibonacci — inward · edge → core
palettes.formula: Golden-ratio log spiral: radius changes by φ each 90° turn.

geometry.verdict: Every color has max(R,G,B) = 118: the set sits on a single brightness shell, which is all one wheel brightness can reach. More volume than a neutral ramp + one accent produces, which points to two or more independent chroma directions. Within the range of random wheel picks at this brightness.

palettes.formula: Julia-inspired phase modulation on a φ-scaled spiral, nodes every 45° (exploratory, not a canonical Julia spiral). The phase term is non-zero at t = 0, so node 00 sits slightly off your exact colour -- same as the HTML.
